title: DeleteThreadResult
description:
Result of the `thread/delete` RPC.

`deleted` is `true` when a persistent row or rollout file was removed. `false` indicates the thread was not found (idempotent delete). When the thread has an active turn the server returns an error instead of this type.

# Examples

``` use zhive_proto::rpc::DeleteThreadResult; let r = DeleteThreadResult::new(true); let v = serde_json::to_value(&r).unwrap(); assert_eq!(v["deleted"], true); let back: DeleteThreadResult = serde_json::from_value(v).unwrap(); assert_eq!(back, r); ```

deleted.description: `true` when a row/rollout existed and was removed; `false` when the thread was unknown (idempotent).
